notes.title: TEST score v1 — keep fixed
notes.body: 120 BPM · D major · 4 bars · 64 sixteenths (125 ms). Pitch Hold is not a rest: separate gate controls note length. Trigger has a pulse at every written onset including legato. Velocity stays at the last strike through release. Pitch reference A4 = 440 Hz. First slot and final 4 slots are silent.

notes.title: Simple reference tone
notes.body: One triangle plus a quiet octave transient. Dry, deliberately plain and easy to compare. Gate controls ADSR, Trigger controls separate transient, Velocity scales the final instrument. This is a test signal, not an approved instrument preset.

notes.title: TEST · Instrument audition v1
notes.body:
120 BPM · 8-second loop.
1. Reset transport, Play. Listen to the plain reference.
2. Add another playable instrument or design an editable composite with matching inputs. Connect Pitch, Gate and Velocity (or Trigger for a struck sound), then Audio to the mixer. Use the appropriate port reference.
3. Mute the entire inactive instrument (not the driver) and match levels with its mixer connection. Compare solo, then in a piece.
4. Save as a new named patch. Keep this test score unchanged.

overview.title: TEST — Melody driver / instrument audition v1
overview.description: Repeatable D-major 4-bar test score; separate pitch, gate, trigger and velocity. Replace the plain reference voice while preserving the score.
overview.instructions: Reset transport, play at 120 BPM. Connect driver outputs to a candidate instrument and its Audio to the root mixer. Match levels, mute inactive instrument, compare and save a copy. Pitch reference A4. See the modern pop instrument guide.
